headline: A little closer.
A little clearer.
intro: The last look before you leave. The smallest touch-up along the way. Meet Compact, your pocket mirror with a closer view and light you can make your own.
heroNote: Small details. A little more confidence.

storyIntro: A few thoughtful tools. Right where you need them.

steps.title: Start with you.
steps.body: Open Compact to your front-camera reflection. No photo to take. No camera roll to scroll through. Just a moment to check in.

steps.title: Get closer to the detail.
steps.body: A stray brow. The edge of your eyeliner. Pinch to magnify up to 5×, or choose a preset for a closer look.

steps.title: Keep your focus.
steps.body: Select an eye, both eyes, your nose or lips. Feature lock follows the area you choose as you move, so you can concentrate on the touch-up.

steps.title: Find your light.
steps.body: Give your reflection a little light. Adjust the intensity and move between warm, neutral and cool tones to suit the moment.

privacyHeading:
A mirror.
Not a camera roll.
privacyBody: Camera images and facial landmarks are processed on your device. Compact does not save or upload them. No account, microphone or photo-library access is needed.

faqs.question: What makes Compact different from the Camera app?
faqs.answer: Compact is designed for looking, rather than taking a photo. It combines a front-camera mirror with up to 5× magnification, adjustable screen lighting and facial-feature lock.

faqs.question: Which details can I follow?
faqs.answer: You can select one eye, both eyes, your nose or your lips. Tracking works best with a clearly visible face, and you can unlock the view at any time.

faqs.question: How does the light work?
faqs.answer: Compact uses the screen to light your face. You can change its intensity and warmth, with warm, neutral and cool options. Each fresh camera session starts with the light off.

faqs.question: Does Compact record my face?
faqs.answer: No. Camera images and facial landmarks are processed on your device and are not saved or uploaded by Compact.

faqs.question: When can I download it?
faqs.answer: Compact is coming soon for iPhone and iPad. This page is a preview; an App Store link will be added when it is available.
